english:
RESEARCH REPORT – 14 DEC 1949
SITE DELTA
DR. JANE HICKS

Samples 1, 2, and 3 exhibit near identical viscosity and density. Texture is comparable to partially crystallized molasses. Material resists deformation and maintains cohesive structure under light pressure.

Sample 4 presents in a near-solid state. Limited pliability observed. Structural rigidity greater than previous samples.

Samples 5 and 7 demonstrate elastic qualities. Material is markedly malleable and flexible, returning to form after moderate extension.

Sample 6 exhibits abnormal surface growth formations. Irregular protrusions observed. Adhesive properties present. Bonds readily to metallic and mineral surfaces.

All specimens share identical elemental composition under testing. External conditions do not appear to determine structural state. We have catalogued physical characteristics only. No explanation has yet been determined for the variance in form or behavior.

english:
To my wife, my son, and my best friend, Stella:

I failed you all. I am ashamed it took until now for me to see it. I've spent so much of the last twenty years running from one thing to the next that I lost sight of all of you. 

Elena, Ellie, la mia Luna - I'm so sorry for my distance these last few years. We went into the attraction, into DES, as a team and I cut you out of it when we had DJ, thinking like my father instead of how I should've. I can't come back from that. And chances are, I can't come back either way, so know that even though I tarnished everything, I never stopped loving you. I just had myself convinced that I didn't need you. I was wrong. You were right. You always are. 

Dalton Jr... DJ - I used to hate your nickname, thinking that you wanted to get away from the name that I gave you. But I've spent the last two hours screaming your nickname, hoping to find you, because I know that's what you respond to. Buddy, Daddy's so sorry for not believing you and for not believing IN you. You're a little boy. You needed me to lift you up, not knock you down. But it's not too late for you, my son. You can grow up to be the man I didn't have the guts to become. Take care of Mama for me. Listen to her. She will help you become who you are meant to be. Auntie Stella will be there the whole way, too. 

Stella - ah, Stel. In some ways, you're the most patient with me. We've been good friends, ah screw it, best friends for nearly 25 years and... money rotted us through me. God, I wish I could go back and listen to you back in the '80s. You told me the attraction should be small and sweet, focus on the science and educating our guests. You warned me that it was too much, that the good times wouldn't last, that I had to be smart about it. And what did I do? Messed it all up. I'm done, Stel. It's over. And if I don't make it back, take care of Ellie and DJ for me. You've been a better friend than I've deserved. 

With all the love in the vastness of this universe,
Dalton (Daddy)
before:

너희 모두를 실망시켰어. 이제야 깨달았다는 게 부끄럽다. 지난 20년 동안 이 일에서 저 일로 뛰어다니느라 너희를 보지 못했어.

엘레나, 엘리, 나의 달... 지난 몇 년간 멀어진 것에 정말 미안해. 우리는 한 팀으로 공원과 DES를 시작했는데, DJ가 태어나자 내가 당신을 밀어냈어. 마땅히 해야 할 방식이 아니라 내 아버지처럼 생각했던 거야. 그건 되돌릴 수 없어. 어차피 나도 돌아가지 못할 가능성이 크니까, 내가 모든 걸 더럽혔어도 당신을 사랑하지 않은 적은 없었다는 걸 알아줘. 다만 당신이 필요 없다고 스스로를 속였어. 내가 틀렸어. 당신이 옳았어. 언제나 그랬듯이.

달턴 주니어... DJ. 예전에는 네 별명이 싫었어. 내가 준 이름에서 벗어나려는 것 같았거든. 그런데 지난 두 시간 내내 너를 찾으려고 그 별명을 외쳤어. 그 이름에 네가 대답한다는 걸 아니까. 아들아, 네 말을 믿지 않고 너 자신을 믿어 주지 않아서 정말 미안하다. 넌 어린아이인데, 깎아내리는 대신 북돋아 주는 아빠가 필요했어. 하지만 넌 아직 늦지 않았어. 아들아, 넌 내가 용기가 없어 되지 못한 어른이 될 수 있어. 나 대신 엄마를 돌봐 줘. 엄마 말을 들어. 네가 되어야 할 사람이 되도록 도와줄 거야. 스텔라 이모도 끝까지 함께할 거야.

스텔라... 스텔. 어떻게 보면 넌 누구보다 나를 참아 줬지. 거의 25년 동안 좋은 친구, 아니 빌어먹을, 가장 친한 친구였는데... 돈이 나를 통해 우리를 썩게 했어. 세상에, 80년대로 돌아가 네 말을 들을 수 있다면 얼마나 좋을까. 공원은 작고 정겹게, 과학과 손님 교육에 집중하라고 했지. 너무 과하다고, 좋은 시절이 영원하진 않다고, 현명하게 해야 한다고 경고했어. 그런데 난 뭘 했지? 전부 망쳤어. 난 끝이야, 스텔. 다 끝났어. 돌아가지 못하면 나 대신 엘리와 DJ를 돌봐 줘. 넌 내가 받을 자격도 없는 훌륭한 친구였어.

이 광활한 우주의 모든 사랑을 담아,
달턴 (아빠)
